title: How to trigger event?
body: Say, for example: I want to trigger the clear filters action on demand how would I go about that? I noticed that the script does not use normal registration of events (or from what the Chrome debugger says at least)

comments.body:
Hi @Sammaye could you maybe create a small jsFiddle to show how far you went in term of trying to trigger a click on the clear button programmatically?

Thanks

Indeed jQuery.trigger will not work here since jQuery.trigger only triggers events that were registered through jQuery event handling.

You might have better results by using this: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Guide/Events/Creating_and_triggering_events#Triggering_built-in_events

Or any non jQuery way to trigger a click. Try this and if it does not work you will have to create a [custom widget](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/documentation/#custom-widgets) and use the [helper](https://community.algolia.com/algoliasearch-helper-js/) inside it.
Problem is that code is IE 11 and up by that document. Is there anything that support less? I mean we run the js on jquery 1.13 and it seems to work just great so maybe there is a hacky way?
Ok so actually I misread the document, the old fashioned way (which I had forgotten since using jQuery) works
Awesome, can you provide the detailed fix you used? For further reference.
